node.statement: Spectral-correction package: in the Banach algebra of completely bounded maps under composition, F=Phi-Phi^2 has norm_cb at most eta, A0=2Phi-I satisfies A0^2=I-4F, B=(I-4F)^(-1/2) is given by the convergent binomial series, S=A0 B satisfies S^2=I, and tilde-Phi=(I+S)/2 is an idempotent unital star-preserving map with ||tilde-Phi-Phi||_cb at most r=(3/2)((1-4eta)^(-1/2)-1); consequently its image is a closed complete self-adjoint operator space containing I, and r=O(eta) universally.
